vulnerabilities.description: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login form. Attacker can extract entire database contents including user credentials.
Command injection vulnerability allows arbitrary command execution on the server via unsanitized ping parameter.
File upload allows PHP files via double extension bypass (shell.php.jpg), enabling remote code execution.
Reflected XSS vulnerability in search parameter allows execution of arbitrary JavaScript in user browsers.
Stored XSS in user profile bio field persists malicious scripts affecting all visitors.
User ID enumeration allows access to other users' data by modifying ID parameter.
Admin API endpoints accessible without proper authentication token validation.
Missing X-Frame-Options header allows clickjacking attacks.
No Content-Security-Policy header configured, increasing XSS attack surface.
Strict-Transport-Security header missing, vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks.
Missing X-Content-Type-Options header allows MIME type sniffing attacks.
Session cookies missing Secure and HttpOnly flags.
Server version exposed in HTTP headers: Apache/2.4.25
Directory listing enabled on backup folder exposing sensitive files.
